    AI Overview
    +5
    The federal tax filing deadline for individuals to submit 2025 tax returns is April 15, 2026. Taxpayers can request an automatic 6-month extension by this date, moving the filing deadline to October 15, 2026. Note that an extension only grants more time to file, not more time to pay taxes owed. 
    Key Deadlines & Details 
    • Tax Day: April 15, 2026, for filing returns and paying any owed taxes.
    • Extension Deadline: October 15, 2026.
    • First Quarter 2026 Estimated Tax Payment: Due April 15, 2026.
    • Military/Foreign Duty: Taxpayers stationed outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico on April 15 receive an automatic extension to June 16, 2026. 
    Important Information 
    • Where to File: Use the IRS Free File or authorized e-file software to submit electronically.
    • Late Penalties: Failing to file on time can lead to a penalty of 5% of the tax due per month.
    • Missing Deadline: If you missed the deadline, file as soon as possible to minimize interest and penalties.
    • Refunds: Electronic returns with refunds are typically processed within 21 days. 
    For further details and to check the status of a refund, visit the official IRS website.

    Can I file a return after 15 September?
    Yes, if you failed to file ITR within the due date, you can still file a belated return before 31st December of the relevant assessment year. In case you fail to file a belated return, you can still file an updated return within 48 months (4 years) from the end of the relevant assessment year.

    In the United States, Tax Day is the day on which individual income tax returns are due to be submitted to the federal government. Since 1955, Tax Day has typically fallen on or just after April 15. Tax Day was first introduced in 1913, when the Sixteenth Amendment was ratified.
